payload.application_scope: Ledger item 7 only: the decomposition of the L/N0/Npc word-side Hessian identity into a leading term, one cross term and the handle planes, together with the hypotheses each sector actually needs. No coefficient module, marking, field, resolver, eta or source certificate is selected: every signature theorem is quantified over all of them.

decomposition.note: hessShape leading cross planes = leading + cross + sum over j of planes j, with j ranging over the h handle planes.

payload.hash_scope: Identity of the serialized decomposition, hypothesis list and handle-plane count at the stated discrete parameters. It is not a hash of any proof.

sectors.cross: the polar pairing of c1 against the image of c0 under the normal-form operator Phi

sectors.leading: the named unramified diagonal npcUnramifiedDiagonal, not a bare quadratic value

sectors.cross: the polar pairing of c1 against the eta-twisted image of c0

hypotheses.role: every module element is its own negative
q is a quadratic form over F2, not merely a function

payload.warning: Item 7's carriers are theorems, not records with data fields, so no value is bound by rfl here. The driver restates each identity through the named decomposition hessShape and discharges the restatement by the tree's own theorem, so a wrong decomposition does not compile. What is certified is the decomposition and its three subterms. The human labels below are prose, not Lean, exactly like the item 6 clause roles.
